name: keyboard-spatial-grid
title: Keyboard Spatial Grid
description: A 2D navigation grid supporting full directional arrow key navigation, spatial focus retention, and enter activation.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Mosaic
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Spatial Arrow Key Navigation: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
